phase: LR screen; fresh selection algorithm and seeds already fixed

scientific_design.compute_axis: Equal sampled targets and equally bounded family LR tuning; measured time/memory/cache reported separately, not equal training FLOPs.
scientific_design.parametrization: Native same constructor scheme, inherited width rates and UNIT residual branches; no claim of shared weights or optimal depth transfer.
scientific_design.retained_high_water: Pilot plus all screens: four endpoint pairs per arm. After exact dependency-closed pilot/loser retirement: one selected plus three fresh pairs per arm.
scientific_design.selection: For each arm select minimum full-validation H200 CE over its three rates; lower LR breaks exact ties.
scientific_design.simultaneous_scope: Bonferroni over two contrasts and three block lengths, conditional on these trained seeds and reused validation text.
